messages:
Lina (Sales): Quick sync — AtlasBank wants a POC next quarter. Requirements: EU+UK-only processing/storage, BYOK, no telemetry exports to non-EU/UK vendors, and they'd like a 99.97% region SLA during the POC. Expect ~120 rps peak, PII/KYC. Need feasibility & a blocker list before I take to procurement tomorrow.

Diego (SE): We can do tenant geofencing to EU+UK with Dedicated. Two immediate Qs: do they require synchronous cross-region HA or is async replication OK? Also, do they accept "alerts" that contain metadata (no payload) sent to an ops vendor outside region?

Lina (Sales): They want synchronous HA within EU/UK boundaries if possible. Alerts containing hashed IDs are OK, but full payload cannot leave EU/UK. They asked explicitly for a subprocessors whitelist before signing.

Priya (Infra): Ops note: default topology supports primary in eu-west-1 (Ireland) + optional sync replica in eu-west-3 (Paris) or eu-north-1 (Stockholm). UK (eu-uk-south) can be included but adds network peer setup. Sync HA across EU+UK will need stretched storage and low-latency links — doubles some costs. Timeline: baseline EU-only Dedicated: ~5 business days. Add BYOK onboarding + peering + certs: +5 business days. Synchronous HA across EU+UK: +7-10 business days.

Nora (Security): Telemetry/export constraint: we can route logs/metrics to an EU-only observability stack. However, our on-call paging uses a third-party pager in US. We can proxy alerts via an EU webhook to the pager to avoid sending payloads, but there remains metadata flow. We can redact PII at the source for logs. Will draft a redaction plan.

Compliance Bot: We can generate a Subprocessor List + DPA amendment PDF. Note: we have 3 operational subprocessors that currently process telemetry metadata in non-EU regions for capacity reasons (alerting vendor, crash-reporting vendor, some CDN control planes). We can offer a contractual restriction and attestation but cannot physically relocate those vendors immediately.

Diego (SE): Pricing guess for presales call: base Dedicated POC commit + BYOK onboarding fee: ~+35% vs hosted. Synchronous HA (stretched) add ~+40% on top. If we choose cold-standby (async replication) that's only +15% instead of +40%. For 120 rps POC, suggest quoting a conservative "~+50-80% uplift" until finance gives numbers.

Priya (Infra): I'll open INFRA-13001 to track network/KMS work and add a subprocessors mapping. I'll attach a quick cost sketch there. Also adding runbook note: 
```n
topology=dedicated
region_pin=eu+uk
ha_mode=sync-stretched (or async-cold)
kms=customer_managed
telemetry=eu_only_redacted
```n

Lina (Sales): Good. Can security/ops provide a short "yes/no" block list for procurement: i) absolute non-EU processing allowed? ii) ability to withhold telemetry full payload from leaving region? iii) estimated lead time?

Nora (Security): i) No absolute guarantee we can remove all non-EU subprocessors; we can provide contractual restrictions and attestations. ii) Yes, we can redact and block payloads from leaving region; logs will be EU-hosted. iii) Lead time: 10-20 business days depending on HA choice and how fast BYOK keys are provided.

Priya (Infra): I'll try to get a preliminary cost range by EOD and link subprocessors: https://redwood.example.com/internal/subprocessors/eu-uk-map. INFRA-13001 will have details.

Lina (Sales): Perfect. I'll tell AtlasBank: (a) EU+UK Dedicated + BYOK possible, (b) synchronous HA possible but costs/time increase, (c) we will provide a Subprocessor List and DPA amendment, (d) final pricing after finance.

Diego (SE): One-liner for procurement: "Redwood can provide EU+UK-only Dedicated with customer-managed KMS and telemetry redaction; synchronous HA across EU/UK is supported at additional cost and a multi-week lead time."

Compliance Bot: Action items created: Generate DPA amendment draft (CMP-4822), Subprocessor attestation template queued.

Lina (Sales): Thanks all. I'll push for AtlasBank's security questionnaire now. Ping here if infra/finance updates. :white_check_mark:
